# La Taqueria

> Authentic Mexican restaurant in Bergen (Engen 8). Fresh tacos, burritos and fajitas, plus catering, taco buffet and takeaway via Wolt and Foodora. Slogan: "Taco to the people".

- Address: Engen 8, 5011 Bergen, Norway
- Phone: +47 403 18 407
- Email: post@lataqueria.no
- Opening hours: Monday–Thursday and Sunday 14:00–21:30, Friday–Saturday 14:00–22:30
- Cuisine: Mexican

## Book and order

- [Book a table](https://booking.gastroplanner.no/lataqueria/t)
- [Delivery via Wolt](https://wolt.com/en/nor/bergen/restaurant/la-taqueria-bergen)
